protocol.model_selection: Best validation MSE for each new fit; routing fixed before training.
baseline_arms: Sangam CIL with point steering regression
candidate_arms: ordinal steering loss for turn branches; MSE of expected steering elsewhere
protocol.collection_and_tuning_scope: Training roads must remain spatially separated from all reserved evaluation roads.
protocol.termination_scope: Brake and end at the first control sample with absolute cross-track error greater than or equal to 7.0 m.

metric_definitions.first_2p2m: Route station at first sample with absolute cross-track error at least 2.2 m, or terminal station if never reached.
metric_definitions.cte_stop: Stop on the first sample whose absolute cross-track error meets or exceeds 7.0 m, with zero throttle and full brake.
metric_definitions.terminal_progress: Route station at the final logged sample, even if stopped for a separate terminal condition.

aggregation.scope: Repeated closed-loop runs on two fixed held-out courses and the same training seed.
